verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents per-link meeting caps by day, week, and month, which covers the daily booking cap part of the story. A generic claim about setting rules on each link backs this up but names no specific protections. Missing for 10: buffers before/after meetings, minimum scheduling notice, date-range booking windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows

citations.quote: Limit how many meetings are allowed on a per-day, week, and month basis.
Prevent meeting overload and cap quantity per day, week, and month.
Set a few rules on each link, and SavvyCal keeps your schedule sane.
